parsing_rationale: The provided document is a template for a technical implementation plan rather than a completed plan. It contains placeholders and instructional text. I have extracted the structural intent and the specific technical categories defined in the template, mapping them to the required compliance graph. Since no concrete technical decisions or entities were provided (only placeholders like '[e.g., Python 3.11]'), the elements represent the required architectural decisions the project must make.
